divergence_log: Classical PCA variance-explained uses a real symmetric sample-covariance matrix with non-negative eigenvalues and commuting directions. Lost relative to the nonclassical/qPCA shell: density-matrix coherences and relative phases between principal directions, noncommuting probe covariances (uncertainty floor), and distinguishability-constraint-admissible subspaces whose variance decomposition cannot be identified with a classical orthogonal direct sum.
